description: This file contains unit tests for the ControlModuleService component, verifying connection establishment, disconnection, registration, shared memory access, acknowledgment handling, and failure scenarios.

methods.name: shouldEstablishConnection
methods.description: Test that verifies the control module can establish a connection.

methods.name: shouldDisconnect
methods.description: Test that verifies the control module can disconnect properly.

methods.name: shouldFailToRegisterClient
methods.description: Test that verifies failure handling when client registration fails due to invalid controller.

methods.name: shouldRegisterClientAndUnregisterItWhenDisconnected
methods.description: Test that verifies client registration and automatic unregistration upon disconnection.

methods.name: shouldRegisterClientAndUnregisterItWhenDestructed
methods.description: Test that verifies client registration and unregistration upon object destruction.

methods.name: shouldGetSharedMemory
methods.description: Test that verifies retrieval of shared memory from the playback service.

methods.name: shouldFailToGetSharedMemory
methods.description: Test that verifies proper handling when shared memory retrieval fails.

methods.name: shouldFailToAckWhenControlServiceReturnsFailure
methods.description: Test that verifies failure handling when acknowledgment fails.

methods.name: shouldAck
methods.description: Test that verifies acknowledgment process completes successfully.
